name: Force eTap AXS crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed non-power crankset reference: 172.5 mm arms, 48/35T chainrings, DUB spindle; excludes bottom bracket. SRAM’s 2024 sheet lists the Force eTap AXS D1 crankset separately from the DUB BSA bottom bracket and power-meter option. This is the sourced 172.5 mm reference, not an estimated 170 mm weight.
